sections.title: Sound of letter á
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (á) /aː/. It has one sound. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. You hear this vowel in the word (ár) /ˈaːr/, which means price, flood. It always makes this same sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Open your mouth wide and drop your jaw. Keep your tongue low and flat. Spread your lips slightly. A voiced sound is a sound where the voice is on. Turn your voice on and hold the sound. Put a hand on your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always has an accent mark. An accent mark is a diacritic written above a letter. It makes the same sound in all positions. You hear this long vowel in the word (ház) /haːz/. Do not confuse it with the letter without an accent mark, heard in (fa) /fɒ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not shorten this sound. A long sound is a sound that you hold for more time. English words like cat have a very different, tight vowel. Say the open vowel in father instead, but stretch it longer. Keep your tongue flat and relaxed throughout the whole sound.
